name: chest

mesh_simplified.why: Tencent's parts are up to ~1M faces; PhysX convex hulls stalled

code_options_added.warning: hinge_arms applies to every hinge: one chose an arm, another its own edge

self_test: [GOLEM] SELFTEST chest (GOLEM)/door_1: turned 70.50 deg of +70.00 deg, right way, drag agrees -> PASS
[GOLEM] SELFTEST chest (GOLEM)/lid_1: turned 69.65 deg of +70.00 deg, right way, drag agrees -> PASS
[GOLEM] SELFTEST chest (GOLEM)/lid_2: turned 69.99 deg of +70.00 deg, WRONG WAY, drag agrees -> FAIL

part_03.why: Vertical riveted metal strap wrapping the front-left corner of the box body; it lies flush against the wood panels, its top edge stops at the fixed lid seam, and there are no hinge knuckles or slide t

part_05.why: Riveted metal corner strap on the front-right corner running down the body edge and flush with the panel seams; no gap, pivot or runner is visible anywhere along it, so it is rigidly fixed to the box.

part_07.why: Thin riveted metal base rail along the bottom rear edge of the chest, flush with the bottom and back boards; it has no track, gap or hinge line, so it cannot slide out or swing.

part_08.why: Front panel of the lid with the lock centred on it; the hinge runs along its top edge and it opens backward, as expected for a chest lid.

part_10.why: Right side end cap of the lid; no handle or hinge seam, and it is reinforced with fixed metal corner brackets and rivets, so it is not separately movable.

part_12.why: Left side end cap of the lid; no handle or hinge seam, and it is reinforced with fixed metal corner brackets and rivets, so it is not separately movable.

part_13.why: In the back-right view this is the small riveted metal corner bracket/strap sitting on the body at the lid seam on the chest's right side, exactly matching the 'metal corner brackets' of the prop. It

part_15.why: In the back and back-right views this is the large wooden back/side panel of the body: it runs the full height and width of the box, flush with the corner straps and the bottom rail, with no handle, l

part_21.why: This is a thin flat board at the very bottom of the chest (lowest y, inside the four walls). It is the chest floor, enclosed by the side/front/back walls and the corner straps, with no handle, pull, s

part_24.why: Side panel on the left side with a metal ring handle and a visible seam around it; no hinges are visible on the other edges, so it opens outward like a small side door hinged at its bottom-left edge.

part_25.why: Front panel with a central latch/lock and a horizontal gap underneath; as the chest lid it hinges at its back edge and opens upward, and the ~87 degree free swing matches a lid rather than a drawer.

chain: raw model -> split (parts) -> sweep (pass/fail, free range) -> tie-break (pick among passed) -> choices -> Blender split + joints -> Unity PhysX self-test -> video
what_this_proves: Each file's hash shows it hasn't changed since this run; the request ids identify the calls in Tencent's and Hyper3D's records. The hashes are written by the machine that ran the pipeline: they don't prove who ran it. fallbacks_used lists every step that didn't take the primary path.
